description: This file defines a CurrencyFormatter class for formatting currency values, including functions for normalizing currency codes, retrieving currency symbols, and handling auto currency modes. It is part of a larger project related to currency formatting in data visualization or reporting.

classes.name: CurrencyFormatter
classes.description: A class extending ExtensibleFunction to format currency values based on configuration, supporting auto currency detection and symbol positioning.

methods.name: getCurrencySymbol
methods.description: Retrieves the currency symbol for a given currency code using Intl.NumberFormat.

methods.name: normalizeCurrency
methods.description: Normalizes a currency code string, returning uppercase ISO 4217 code if valid.

methods.name: hasMixedCurrencies
methods.description: Checks if an array of currency codes contains multiple different currencies.
